digest.component_or_area: Mirror Guard replication check / GitHub Actions workflow
propositions: The workflow's primary replication check samples divergence once per cron tick and fails on a single instantaneous inequality, causing red runs during expected post-submit replication lag that self-heals within minutes.

The module's docstring (d96628c9dca) delegates transient-lag absorption to the alarm layer's sustained-divergence evaluation window, but the workflow implementation never built that window on the workflow surface.
The CloudWatch secondary watcher (monitoring_ws7.tf) correctly implements a 2x5-min sustained-divergence window to suppress transient lag, while the primary CLI/workflow path has no lag tolerance.

Adding an in-process, scheduler-agnostic evaluation window to mirror_guard.py's run() and main() (with configurable attempts and delay, defaulting to 3 samples × 45s) will suppress transient lag that converges within the window while preserving failure for persistent divergence.
Missing or immediately-converged SHA samples will not re-sample, maintaining the current immediate-failure behavior for true outages while self-healing lag exits cleanly within the configured window.
